description: This is an HTML source file for a web-based database visualizer interface. It contains the structure, styles, and client-side logic (JavaScript) for browsing databases, tables, and displaying table data dynamically.
external_files: fetch API (used for server data fetching)
published: none (not a module or library file)

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases from the server and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases, resets current selections, and updates UI.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Toggles the display of tables for a specific database.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Loads the tables for a selected database and displays them in the sidebar.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads data for a selected table and renders it within the main content area.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Creates an HTML table to display fetched row data.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Generates HTML for individual cell contents, including handling for objects and long strings.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content when clicked, showing full JSON or lengthy text.
